parsed.reason: The core facts match the notes. The lowest 5-year fixed is 4.34% (Frank Mortgage per WOWA, Ratehub as of Oct 12), and big banks sit around 5.1–5.2% (nesto Big 6 averages 5.14–5.17%, BMO 5.14%). Rates are climbing in October, which the notes also support. Two problems keep the score down. First, it lumps 'some credit unions' in at about 4.34%, but the notes show credit unions higher (Meridian 4.59%, Alterna 4.69%). It also leaves out that 4.34% is the insured/high-ratio rate. Second, the closing line, 'if you tell me whether you're under 20% down, I can narrow it down', reads like an assistant offering a service rather than a friend texting back.
